info.title: SIH26002 - NER Smart Logistics & Accessibility Intelligence Platform
info.description: Backend API for the AI-Based Smart Logistics & Accessibility Intelligence Platform for the North Eastern Region (SIH26002).

post.description:
Register a new user.

- Role is forced to 'field_official' by schema validation (prevents
  privilege escalation).
- Duplicate username or email returns 409.

Authenticate and return access + refresh tokens.

Accepts OAuth2 form fields (username, password) so Swagger's built-in
Authorize dialog works directly.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair.

get.description:
Public — returns district-wise road/bridge connectivity summary.

All counts come from database aggregation queries, not hard-coded values.
Uses case-insensitive district matching.
Returns 404 if no roads exist for the given district.

post.description: Admin only - create a new empty route.
Admin only - add an ordered road segment to a route. Enforces 5km geographic continuity.

Public — calculate a shortest-path route between arbitrary coordinates.

Snaps origin and destination to the nearest road edges, then computes
the optimal path using Haversine distance weights.

Returns a GeoJSON Feature containing a LineString geometry and metadata.
